select due_dt from t2000_complain_category where complain_category_id = #{complainCategoryId}

SELECT SEQ_T2000_COMPLAIN_CATEGORY.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
insert into t2000_complain_category(complain_category_id, category_name, category_cd, create_dt, due_dt, create_id, category_url) values(#{complainCategoryId}, #{categoryName}, #{categoryCd}, SYSDATE, #{dueDt}, #{createId}, #{categoryUrl})
mapper.update: update t2000_complain_category set update_dt=SYSDATE, update_id=#{updateId}, due_dt=#{dueDt}, del_yn=#{delYn}, category_url=#{categoryUrl} where complain_category_id=#{complainCategoryId}
mapper.select:
SELECT cc.complain_category_id, cc.category_name, cc.category_cd, cc.due_dt, cc.category_url, cc.del_yn, TO_CHAR(cc.create_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS create_dt, TO_CHAR(cc.update_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS update_dt, t.code_id, t.code_name FROM t2000_complain_category cc JOIN total_code t ON t.code_id = cc.category_cd
AND cc.del_yn = #{delYn}
AND cc.category_name LIKE '%' || #{categoryName} || '%'
AND cc.category_cd LIKE '%' || #{categoryCd} || '%'
AND cc.category_url LIKE '%' || #{categoryUrl} || '%'
AND cc.create_dt >= TO_DATE(#{createDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND cc.create_dt < TO_DATE(#{updateDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND cc.update_dt >= TO_DATE(#{createDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND cc.update_dt < TO_DATE(#{updateDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND cc.due_dt BETWEEN #{dueStart} AND #{dueEnd}
ORDER BY cc.create_dt DESC, cc.complain_category_id DESC ORDER BY cc.update_dt DESC, cc.complain_category_id DESC ORDER BY cc.complain_category_id DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
